title: Sura 9:128–129 Across the 1981, 1989, and 1992 Editions
archival_description: This dossier tracks Rashad Khalifa's changing treatment of the two passages. It describes edition history and does not independently adjudicate the passages' Quranic status.

edition_sequence.verse_128_candidate:
A messenger has come to you from among you, who is careful not to

impose any hardship on you, and cares about you, and is tolerant and merciful towards the believers.
edition_sequence.verse_129_candidate:
If they turn away, then say, “God suffices me; there is no god except He; 1

trust in Him; and He is the Lord of the great dominion.

edition_sequence.note: The main Sura 9 text ends at 9:127. The page footnote and Appendix 24 argue that 9:128–129 were added after Muhammad's death.
The selected final 1992 verse CSV contains 9:123–127 and no 9:128 or 9:129 records.

transcription_caution: The 1981 and 1989 sources are page transcriptions derived from scans. The scans should be checked before publishing exact quotations.
